NudgeEngine.purpose: Runs the daily top-5 nudge pipeline: filters the Action catalogue by contraindications and acute flags, estimates horizon-indexed ΔPureScore through the exact scoring recompute (§2.5 honesty bound), ranks by ease-weighted utility U_a = [ΔPureScore·ε]^α · p̂^β · (1−E_a)^η · ν, applies a greedy diversity cap (≤2 per class, ≥1 near-zero-effort), guarantees every surfaced action has a strictly positive expected ΔPureScore@h*, and feeds realized adherence back into the reservoir inflow loop (D16).

stories.want: a daily top-5 list of positive-delta, diverse, easy actions
stories.soThat: I know exactly what to do today to improve my PureScore without being overwhelmed or misled
acceptance: Given a patient with no red-flag escalations and no acute mode, When the daily nudge job runs, Then exactly 5 actions are returned, each with a strictly positive ΔPureScore@30d, spanning at least 3 distinct action classes, with the lowest-effort action having E_a ≤ 0.25
Given two actions in the same class competing for a slot, When ranked by U_a, Then at most 2 actions of the same class appear in the top-5 (diversity cap)

Given a patient whose MET pillar is the binding constraint (highest W_k · R_k gradient), When the plan is built, Then at least one slot is reserved for the highest-leverage safe MET action, flagged 'biggest lever', even at higher effort
Given a patient whose every remaining modifiable risk is already green, When the engine runs, Then it returns a 'nothing further to optimize' notice rather than fabricating zero-delta nudges
edge: If all positive-delta actions in the remaining slots belong to one class, the engine may allow a second action from that class but must drop a third rather than violate the positive-delta guarantee

stories.want: the engine to block protein nudges automatically and never surface them
stories.soThat: I cannot be inadvertently harmed by a nutrition recommendation that would worsen my kidney function
acceptance: Given a patient with condition tag CKD_STAGE_3B, When the SafetyFilter runs, Then NUT-PROT and any potassium-raising nutrition action are absent from the candidate set and the block reason is logged to the audit store
Given the blocked action has the highest raw ΔPureScore among nutrition actions, When the final top-5 is assembled, Then the blocked action is still absent and the next safe action fills the slot
Given a red-flag escalation present (e.g. K⁺ ≥ 6.5), When the engine runs, Then no lifestyle tips card is produced; only the escalation pathway is surfaced
Given a patient in acute cardiac mode, When ACT-Z2 is evaluated, Then it is filtered out by the safety gate and the highest-leverage safe ACT action (e.g. ACT-STEPS at low dose) fills the ACT slot
edge: If all ACT actions are contraindicated in acute mode, the ACT class slot is left empty rather than substituting a non-ACT action that would exceed the class cap

stories.want: the adherence signal to flow back and update my reservoir inflow and feasibility model
stories.soThat: my next day's list reflects what I actually did and my predicted adherence improves over time
acceptance: Given a patient who marks ACT-STEPS 'done', When complete-nudge is called, Then a valve event is written to the ReservoirSystem updating B_CRF inflow for the day
Given 7 consecutive completions of ACT-STEPS, When the feasibility model is evaluated, Then p̂_ACT-STEPS increases from cohort prior toward the personal completion rate via empirical-Bayes shrinkage
Given a nudge snoozed 5 consecutive days, When ν_a is computed, Then its novelty/anti-nag penalty reduces U_a enough to rotate a different action into the slot
edge: Partial completion (e.g. 50% of step target) writes a proportional valve signal, not a binary miss

stories.role: FH patient whose lifestyle cannot move genetic ApoB
stories.want: the engine to route to a clinician referral instead of fabricating lifestyle nudges for an un-modifiable marker
stories.soThat: I am directed to the intervention that can actually help me (medication), not blamed for a genetic risk
acceptance: Given a patient with FH tag and ApoB flagged fixed/low-Modifiability, When NUT-NAK impact is computed via the Modifiability gate, Then the lifestyle effect on ApoB is zeroed and the resulting ΔPureScore@30d is near zero
Given no lifestyle action clears the positive-delta threshold for the CV pillar, When the engine selects the CV slot, Then a CLINICAL referral action is surfaced instead

Given the CLINICAL referral is surfaced, When the card is rendered, Then the explanation states 'This risk is largely genetic — lifestyle changes alone cannot move it; your clinician can prescribe medication that can' (Modifiability framing, D5/D16)
edge: Even for FH patients, MEASURE actions (e.g. MSR-APOB to raise coverage) remain eligible if coverage is low, as they carry independent positive ΔPureScore via uncertainty reduction

table.name: daily_nudge_plan

columns.name: plan_date
columns.note: UTC date of the nudge clock tick (Δ = 1 day)

columns.name: model_version_id
columns.note: versioned constants snapshot used for this plan

columns.name: realized_delta_30d
columns.note: filled at horizon by feedback loop (§6)

indexes: INDEX (action_id, plan_date DESC) — for per-action calibration queries
PARTIAL INDEX (patient_id) WHERE completion_status IS NULL — open nudges
table.notes: Time-series table: one row per patient per day per rank position. realized_delta_30d backfilled by the §6 calibration job at t+30d, enabling predicted-vs-realized Brier tracking (D17).

invariants: Every row with rank 1–5 has predicted_delta_30d > 0 (strictly positive expected delta, D16/D23)
No action_id present in the plan has a safety block logged for this patient on this date
At most 2 rows per (patient_id, plan_date) share the same action.class_a value (diversity cap)
model_version_id is immutable after insert; recalculation requires a new plan_date row
realized_delta_30d is never backfilled if the patient's state lacks a clean 30-day counterfactual (null preferred over fabricated)

Action.purpose: Versioned catalogue of candidate actions available to the NudgeEngine. Each action is a structured record (not free text) carrying: the reservoir valve(s) it turns or marker(s) it moves, nominal per-unit effect vector e_a, normalized effort E_a, evidence strength ε_a, latency τ_a, the realization curve g_a(h), safety contraindication keys, and cohort applicability tags. The catalogue is the single source of truth for impact estimation, safety filtering, and diversity capping.

stories.want: to fetch a filtered, cohort-appropriate action candidate set for a patient
stories.soThat: only safe, applicable actions enter the ranking stage
acceptance: Given a 68-year-old post-menopausal woman with osteoporosis, When the ActionCatalogue is queried, Then ACT-RES is returned tagged 'supervised only' (not blocked, but dose-modified) and high-impact resistance actions at unsafe loads are absent
Given a patient on anticoagulants, When the catalogue is queried, Then NUT-O3 (high-dose omega-3) is absent from the candidate set with reason 'bleeding risk'
Given a patient whose ApoB coverage is low (imputed), When the catalogue is queried, Then MSR-APOB appears as a first-class MEASURE action with a non-zero ΔPureScore credit for coverage improvement
Given a patient in acute cardiac mode, When the catalogue is queried, Then ACT-Z2 is absent and ACT-STEPS returns with a reduced dose variant
edge: An action blocked for one contraindication key may still appear in a dose-adjusted form if the cohort template supplies an override variant (e.g. supervised resistance for osteoporosis)

stories.want: to update valve efficacy e_a and realization curve g_a(h) when realized-vs-predicted diverges
stories.soThat: action impact estimates remain honest and self-correcting
acceptance: Given systematic over-prediction for ACT-STEPS in the 60–70 age band, When the §6 calibration job runs, Then e_a for ACT-STEPS in that cohort is shrunk and the model_version_id bumps
Given a new model version, When the NudgeEngine builds a plan, Then it uses only the new version's e_a and g_a values, and old daily_nudge_plan rows are not retroactively recomputed
Given ε_a = 0.5 (weak evidence) for an action, When ΔPureScore is quoted to the patient, Then the displayed number is 50% of the raw chain-rule estimate, and the card shows 'emerging evidence'
edge: If a guideline update changes e_a by more than a governance threshold, the change is staged for human review before taking effect (D20)

stories.want: to add a new action to the catalogue via the admin-constants API
stories.soThat: new evidence-backed interventions can be deployed without code changes
acceptance: Given a new action proposal submitted via admin-constants, When the governance gate runs, Then the proposal enters a staged state and is not used by NudgeEngine until a clinician approves and a model-version bump is issued

Given an approved new action missing a safe_a contraindication key, When it is added to the catalogue, Then the safety filter treats the empty key set as 'no contraindications recorded' and logs a coverage warning
edge: Deleting an action from the catalogue is non-destructive: existing daily_nudge_plan rows retain the action_id for calibration history; the action is flagged deprecated and filtered from future plans

table.name: action

columns.name: model_version_id
columns.note: version at which this record was active

columns.name: evidence_strength
columns.note: ε_a ∈ [0,1]; applied as discount on quoted ΔPureScore

columns.name: safe_contraindications
columns.note: array of contraindication keys checked against patient condition/med tags

columns.name: is_modifiable_only
columns.note: true = lifestyle; Modifiability gate zeroes effect on fixed/genetic markers (D16)

columns.name: deprecated_at
columns.note: null = active; set when superseded by updated evidence

indexes: GIN INDEX (safe_contraindications) — for fast safety-filter intersection
table.notes: Versioned catalogue: each model-version bump may produce new rows or update effect_vector/evidence_strength. Deleted actions are soft-deleted (deprecated_at set) to preserve calibration history.

invariants: evidence_strength ∈ (0, 1]; a zero-evidence action may not appear in the catalogue
effort ∈ [0, 1]; must be set — no nullable effort (SafetyFilter and ranking both require it)
Every MEASURE and CLINICAL action has is_modifiable_only = false (they are not lifestyle gates)
An action's effect_vector may not reference a marker flagged fixed/genetic without a corresponding is_modifiable_only = false (Modifiability gate, D16)
deprecated_at rows never appear in NudgeEngine candidate queries (filter enforced at query layer)

ClinicalPersona.purpose: Assigns a patient to one or more named clinical personas (e.g. healthy, prediabetic, elderly, CKD, FH, pregnancy) via a softmax posterior over objective signals. Personas carry pillar weight multipliers that amplify or dampen pillar contributions for the patient's scoring context (Doc 05/06 cohort frames), gate action eligibility, and are cross-referenced by the NudgeEngine to apply cohort-specific doses and contraindications. Assignment is many-to-many (a patient may hold multiple personas simultaneously); hard sex/age/life-stage priors zero impossible columns first (D25).

stories.want: to derive a patient's active clinical persona(s) from labs, wearables, and validated PRO responses
stories.soThat: pillar weight multipliers and action eligibility reflect the patient's true clinical context, not just their self-report
acceptance: Given a patient with HbA1c 6.1%, waist >90 cm, and HOMA-IR elevated, When the persona posterior is computed, Then 'prediabetic' has the highest softmax weight and MET multiplier 1.6 is applied
Given a patient with a natal-sex prior of female and age 58 with FSH elevated, When the persona matrix is evaluated, Then 'menopause' is eligible and ENDO/BCM/CV multipliers are applied (D15/D25)
Given a patient with FH tag and ApoB > 190 mg/dL unresponsive to lifestyle, When persona assignment runs, Then 'fh' persona is active, CV multiplier 1.5 applied, and ApoB modifiability flagged low
Given a patient with eGFR 38 (CKD stage 3b), When persona posterior is computed, Then 'ckd' persona is active, REN weight elevated, and NUT-PROT contraindication key is set for SafetyFilter
edge: A patient may hold 'prediabetic' and 'shift_worker' simultaneously; weight multipliers from both personas are composed multiplicatively, capped at a maximum per-pillar multiplier to prevent runaway amplification

stories.want: to use persona-level weight multipliers when estimating ΔPureScore for a candidate action
stories.soThat: the same action (e.g. ACT-STEPS) yields a larger estimated ΔPureScore for a patient where the relevant pillar is amplified
acceptance: Given a 'south_asian_metabolic' persona with MET multiplier 1.4, When ACT-STEPS impact is estimated, Then the MET pillar credit is 1.4× the baseline credit for an unweighted patient

Given an 'endurance_athlete' persona with FIT multiplier 0.8 (adaptive lows), When FIT-targeted actions are ranked, Then their ΔPureScore@30d is suppressed relative to a sedentary patient, reducing their rank (D7)
Given a 'frail_elderly' persona with BCM multiplier 1.4, When ACT-RES is safety-checked, Then it is surfaced as 'supervised only' and the BCM pillar credit is amplified accordingly
edge: Persona weight multipliers are applied during the impact chain-rule computation, not as a post-hoc scalar — ensuring the honesty bound (§2.5 exact recompute) is maintained with persona context

stories.want: persona assignments to be auditable and never used to worsen insurance price or restrict access
stories.soThat: the actuarial firewall is enforced and personas serve clinical benefit only
acceptance: Given a persona assignment event, When it is written, Then an audit record is created with the evidence signals that drove the softmax posterior
Given a patient who has not consented to actuarial use, When the ActuarialLayer queries persona data, Then persona assignment records are excluded from the actuarial feed (post-consent gate)
Given any persona assignment, When it is evaluated, Then no persona code is used to raise a patient's insurance premium or restrict clinical access (no-protected-class rule, D18)
edge: Cold-start (no labs): persona posterior defaults to uninformative prior; 'healthy' archetype is assigned with low confidence; weight multipliers revert to 1.0 until evidence accumulates

table.name: clinical_persona_assignment

columns.name: persona_key
columns.note: e.g. prediabetic | fh | ckd | elderly | menopause | pregnancy

columns.name: posterior_weight
columns.note: softmax posterior probability for this persona (D25)

columns.name: weight_multipliers
columns.note: {pillar_code: multiplier} — amplifies/dampens pillar weight in scoring context

columns.name: contraindication_keys
columns.note: array — injected into SafetyFilter for this patient

columns.name: evidence_signals
columns.note: snapshot of lab/wearable/PRO values driving the posterior

columns.name: representative_archetype
columns.note: FK to nearest lifestyle archetype (e.g. south_asian_metabolic)

indexes: INDEX (patient_id, valid_to) WHERE valid_to IS NULL — current assignments
table.notes: Many-to-many: one patient may have multiple active rows (one per persona). valid_to = null means currently active. A new model_version_id triggers re-evaluation of the posterior. Weight multipliers are composed at scoring time across all active personas for the patient.

invariants: No persona assignment is used to increase a patient's insurance price or restrict clinical access (actuarial firewall, D18)
posterior_weight ∈ (0, 1]; sum over concurrent active personas is not required to equal 1.0 (many-to-many)
contraindication_keys in a persona assignment are additive to action-level safe_a keys — never replace them
Sex/age-impossible personas are hard-zeroed in the softmax before normalization (D25 prior gate)
Every persona assignment row has an evidence_signals snapshot for auditability; a row with null evidence_signals is rejected

PerceivedVsActual.purpose: Computes and stores the signed gap between a patient's self-assessed health/behaviour level on each lifestyle axis and the objective level derived from labs, wearables, and validated PROs. The gap record selects a nudge communication strategy (awareness-first, reassurance-first, deload-framing, etc.), adjusts the companion vector Confidence and Modifiability dimensions, and steers NudgeEngine action framing — without ever using the gap to penalise the patient or relax a clinical safety anchor.

stories.want: to detect when a patient over-estimates their fitness level so the nudge is framed as data-led awareness rather than judgment
stories.soThat: the patient is not shamed but is gently confronted with objective evidence that unlocks engagement
acceptance: Given a patient self-reporting 'active' on Q_CORE_SELF_PERSONA but wearable MVPA < 75 min/week, When the gap is computed for axis 'activity', Then gap_direction = 'overconfident_fitness' and nudge_strategy = 'show data gently; one concrete movement target; no shaming'
Given the overconfident_fitness gap is active, When the NudgeEngine selects ACT-STEPS, Then the card framing key is set to 'awareness-first' and includes the wearable MVPA figure
Given the gap resolves (MVPA rises to match self-report) on a subsequent measurement, When the gap is recomputed, Then gap_direction is cleared and nudge_strategy reverts to standard
edge: If wearable data is absent (low trust tier), the gap on the activity axis cannot be computed with confidence; gap_confidence is set low and the awareness-first framing is withheld to avoid false confrontation (D22)

stories.want: the hidden_metabolic gap to raise the Early-warning dimension and trigger an awareness nudge
stories.soThat: a patient who feels well but has pre-diabetes in labs receives actionable, non-alarming awareness before the condition worsens
acceptance: Given a patient reporting 'optimal' metabolic health but HbA1c 5.8% and waist above threshold, When the gap for axis 'metabolic_state' is computed, Then gap_direction = 'hidden_metabolic' and companion Early-warning is raised to Watch tier

Given hidden_metabolic gap and companion Early-warning = Watch, When the daily nudge plan is built, Then the plan includes a MEASURE action (confirmatory test) ranked in the top-2 alongside the highest-yield glycemic lifestyle action
Given the gap is hidden_metabolic and HbA1c subsequently normalizes, When gap is recomputed, Then gap_direction is cleared and Early-warning Watch is withdrawn
edge: If the patient's HbA1c is imputed (low coverage), the hidden_metabolic gap is flagged with a low-confidence caveat and the companion Confidence dimension is reduced, not the Early-warning — preserving sensitivity while being honest about uncertainty

stories.want: the gap to detect that my perceived peak fitness contradicts my poor HRV and sleep debt, and prescribe recovery
stories.soThat: I do not continue training into injury or burnout
acceptance: Given a patient with high self-rated fitness but wearable HRV in the lowest tertile for their cohort and sleep debt flagged, When axis 'activity' gap is computed, Then gap_direction = 'overtrainer' and nudge_strategy = 'validate effort, prescribe deload/recovery; frame rest as performance'
Given the overtrainer gap is active, When the NudgeEngine builds the plan, Then a SLEEP recovery action (SLP-WIND or SLP-REG) is elevated in ranking and ACT-Z2 effort-cap is tightened

Given a patient denies stress but HRV is low and cortisol flat, When axis 'stress_load' gap is computed, Then gap_direction = 'stoic_underreporter' and the companion MCS/ENDO attention flags are raised without surfacing a stress label to the patient unprompted
edge: Wearable HRV is consumer-tier (D22); the overtrainer gap requires corroboration from at least two signals (HRV + sleep debt, or HRV + cortisol proxy) before nudge framing is changed

stories.want: the gap to detect that my self-reported poor health contradicts green labs, and receive reassurance rather than more alarm
stories.soThat: health anxiety is not amplified by the app surfacing more warnings
acceptance: Given a patient rating their health 'poor' or 'very poor' but all pillars green, When the gap for axis 'condition_load' is computed, Then gap_direction = 'catastrophizer' and nudge_strategy = 'reassurance + validation; redirect anxiety into a small mastery action; consider GAD-7'
Given the catastrophizer gap is active, When the NudgeEngine builds the plan, Then the plan leads with a low-effort mastery action and suppresses any 'early-warning' framing that would increase alarm

Given the catastrophizer framing is active, When the MCS pillar has a borderline marker, Then the companion Confidence dimension is raised (data is reliable, patient is well) rather than surfacing an advisory
edge: If a pillar that was previously green genuinely turns yellow while catastrophizer framing is active, safety dominates: the clinical signal is shown truthfully and the catastrophizer framing is suspended for that pillar

table.name: perceived_vs_actual

columns.name: axis_id
columns.note: lifestyle axis: activity | metabolic_state | sleep | stress_load | diet_pattern | substance | condition_load

columns.name: gap_direction
columns.note: overconfident_fitness | hidden_metabolic | catastrophizer | overtrainer | stoic_underreporter | diet_halo | alcohol_blindspot | null (aligned)

columns.name: gap_magnitude
columns.note: ordinal steps between perceived and actual level (-3 to +3); positive = over-estimated

columns.name: nudge_strategy
columns.note: selected strategy text from persona-axes.json gaps catalogue

columns.name: gap_confidence
columns.note: 0–1; reduced when objective signals are imputed or consumer-tier (D22)

columns.name: perceived_signals
columns.note: snapshot of self-report question refs and values driving perceived_level

columns.name: actual_signals
columns.note: snapshot of lab/wearable/PRO values driving actual_level

columns.name: computed_at
columns.note: updated on each measurement ingest or response scored

indexes: UNIQUE (patient_id, axis_id) — one current record per axis; upserted on recompute
INDEX (gap_direction) WHERE gap_direction IS NOT NULL — for population-level gap analytics
PARTIAL INDEX (patient_id) WHERE gap_direction IS NOT NULL — patients with active gaps
table.notes: One row per (patient, axis); upserted whenever new signals arrive. gap_direction = null means perceived ≈ actual (within one ordinal level). The NudgeEngine reads gap_direction and gap_confidence to select framing keys; it never reads raw perceived/actual levels directly.

invariants: gap_direction is null if gap_magnitude = 0 (aligned); non-null gap_direction requires gap_magnitude ≠ 0
gap_confidence ≤ 0.5 when any objective signal driving actual_level is imputed or consumer-tier (D22) — framing is withheld below a gap_confidence threshold
catastrophizer framing never suppresses a genuinely red or critical clinical signal — safety gates dominate regardless of gap_direction
A gap record is never used to penalize a patient actuarially or to restrict clinical access (actuarial firewall)
actual_signals snapshot is immutable after insert; a new measurement triggers a new upsert (computed_at advances), preserving the prior snapshot in audit history via timestamptz ordering
